response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced full-stack/web developer (15+ years) with strong skills in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and JavaScript, but his C++ experience is minimal and dates back nearly a decade (a ~6-month stint at National Instruments and a university thesis project). The role requires deep, current C++/STL expertise combined with industrial cybersecurity knowledge (IEC 62443), MQTT, message brokers, and industrial protocols — none of which appear in his recent work history, which has been almost entirely focused on web platforms, DevOps, and general software craftsmanship.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) across multiple domains and company sizes
Strong background in TDD, CI/CD, and agile software craftsmanship practices
Demonstrated experience with async I/O, fibers, and low-latency/high-performance systems (though in DLang, not C++)
concerns: Virtually no recent hands-on C++ experience; core language usage was brief and nearly 10 years ago
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No exposure to MQTT, message brokers, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.), or IoT/industrial automation domains

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and multi-threaded systems experience (different stack)
